title: Agong's cane
kaylee: Agong's cane is one smooth walking stick: its crook curls into his paw and its rubber foot stands on the floor.

pictures.title: From his side
pictures.caption: The hook was a hollow half-ring next to the stick; now it's one bent stick

pictures.title: From the front
pictures.caption: The crook sits in his paw and the foot touches the floor (it used to sink in)
